familyChat.title: PATHIQ Family Chat
familyChat.subtitle: AI career guidance assistant for parents
familyChat.aiDisclaimer: I am an AI assistant, not a human counsellor. I only share verified, sourced evidence. For complex cases, I can connect you with a qualified counsellor.
familyChat.startHint: Ask me about ITI trades, job prospects, salaries, safety, or future education pathways.
familyChat.consentFirst: Please grant consent to start chatting
familyChat.placeholder: Type your question or use voice input...
familyChat.escalationDistress: I'm concerned about your wellbeing. Please consider speaking with a counsellor or contacting a helpline.
familyChat.escalationOther: This question needs human expertise. Would you like to speak with a counsellor?
familyChat.distressMessage: I'm concerned about what you shared. Please contact a helpline now: iCall (9152987821) or Vandrevala Foundation (1860-2662-345). You don't have to face this alone.
familyChat.footerHint: Press Enter to send • Shift+Enter for new line • Click 🎤 for voice input
familyChat.consentDescription: By proceeding, you agree to the terms shown above.
familyChat.handoffDescription: Your question involves a situation that may benefit from speaking with a qualified human counsellor. PATHIQ can prepare a summary of your conversation to share with them.
familyChat.handoffItem1: A counsellor is not guaranteed to be available immediately
familyChat.handoffItem3: Your conversation summary will be shared only with the counsellor
familyChat.handoffItem4: You can continue chatting with PATHIQ regardless
familyChat.handoffConsentNote: Separate consent is required for counsellor handoff. This is different from session consent.
familyChat.sessionEnded: Session ended. Thank you for using PATHIQ.

errors.sessionFailed: Failed to start session. Please try again.
errors.consentFailed: Failed to record consent. Please try again.
errors.messageFailed: Failed to send message. Please try again.
